svg.title: Heegaard surface atlas · genus 1
svg.desc: A sphere with 2 holes, joined by 1 annuli. Red alpha cores cross blue/green beta curves at the signed black points. Open points mark chart attachments. No projection crossings.
svg.metadata: {"provenance":{},"base_orientation":"-dx wedge dy","alpha_cycles":[{"id":1,"label":"a1","visits":[1,2,3,4,5]}],"joining_disk":null,"genus":1,"model":"punctured sphere + annuli","beta_cycles":[{"id":1,"label":"b1","visits":[1,3,5,2,4]}],"annulus_orientation":"dx wedge dy","annuli":[{"alpha_id":1,"pair":1,"inner_radius":0.43,"core_radius":0.7,"outer_radius":1.0,"plus_boundary":1,"minus_boundary":2,"visits":[1,2,3,4,5],"orientation":"dx wedge dy","outer_map":"base theta = -annulus theta","inner_map":"base theta = annulus theta"}]}
svg.text: The outside continues through ∞. Dashed circles attach to the annuli.
